publishedSpecifications.label: meta description
publishedSpecifications.text: This sophisticated coastal beach house plan offers 3,848 square feet of finished living space, four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and a two-car garage spanning 570 square feet.The home greets visitors with an inviting front porch that sets the tone for a relaxed lifestyle, while an integrated elevator provides seamless accessibility across all three levels.The main living level features a spacious, open-concept flow that connects a gourmet kitchen with a large walk-in pantry to a bright breakfast nook and a formal dining area.An expansive primary suite occupies its own level for ultimate privacy, complemented by three well-appointed secondary bedrooms that offer comfort for family and guests alike.A dedicated game room provides a perfect retreat for leisure, while the inclusion of a home office and a convenient main-level laundry room ensures functional efficiency.Multiple levels of outdoor living are highlighted by stacked porches, a screened porch for bug-free relaxation, and a private balcony for enjoying refreshing coastal breezes.
